# NodoFlux Agente 1.2.0

### New models

- **Claude Sonnet 5 with a full 1M context window.** Anthropic's newest Sonnet
  is now in the chat model picker, with a full million tokens of context on
  every message, so long missions hold much more of their history.
- **Claude Fable 5 is in the model picker.** Pick it per agent or per mission.
- **More OpenAI Codex models.** The Codex picker now lists three more models so
  you can match the model to the job: **GPT-5.4** for everyday coding,
  **GPT-5.4-Mini** for simpler tasks, and **GPT-5.3-Codex-Spark**, an
  ultra-fast coding model.

### Now in your language

- **The new-agent store speaks Spanish and Portuguese.** The built-in agents
  and the model picker inside the store now follow your app language.

### Fixes

- **Windows installs now receive in-app updates.** Starting with this release,
  Windows picks up new versions automatically, just like macOS.

### Before you upgrade

- **Mac:** quit NodoFlux Agente before installing. macOS does not always
  replace a running app cleanly. If in doubt, remove
  `/Applications/NodoFlux Agente.app` and drag the new copy in.
- **Windows x64:** this release fixes in-app updates, so this is the last
  version you may need to install manually. SmartScreen may warn on a fresh
  install; choose "More info" and then "Run anyway".
